turns.speaker: user
turns.text: For my history coursework I can pick any question from a list and I like three of them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why the printing press changed religion in Europe, which has tons of sources.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How ordinary women lived during the industrial revolution, which I find really moving.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or whether a single battle really decided a whole war, which is a bit of a debate topic.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The printing press question is safe because sources are easy to find. The industrial revolution one is the one you sound most excited about, and passion usually shows in the writing. The battle question is great if you like arguing a clear side.
